p: rain in due season: By promising abundance of earthly things, he stirs the mind to consider the rich treasures of the spiritual blessings.
sword go through your land: You shall have no war.
establish my covenant with you: Perform that which I have promised.
tabernacle among you: I will be daily present with you.
bands of your yoke: I have set you at full liberty, while before you were as beasts tied in bands.
covenant: Which I made with you in choosing you to be my people.
my face against you: Read Le 17:10.
seven times more for your sins: That is, more extremely.
iron: You shall have drought and barrenness.
contrary unto me: Or as some read, by fortune, imputing my plagues to chance and fortune.
rob you of your children: Read 2Ki 17:25.
high ways shall be desolate: Because no one dares to pass by it for fear of the beasts.
staff of your bread: That is, the strength by which life is sustained, Eze 4:16,5:16.
oven: One oven will be sufficient for ten families.
will not smell the savour of: I will not accept your sacrifices.
sabbaths: Which I commanded you to keep.
flee: As if their enemies chased them.
them: In that, as they are blameworthy of their fathers faults, they shall be punished as well as their fathers.
The land also shall be left: While they are captives, and without repentance.
covenant of their ancestors: Made to their forefathers.
Sinai by the hand of Moses: Fifty days after they came out of Egypt.
